findings.rule: Sharp internal corners a tool cannot cut
findings.reasoning: Dimension D7 specifies an internal fillet radius of R 0. A milling cutter or turning tool has a finite radius and cannot produce a perfectly sharp internal corner, making this feature unmanufacturable as drawn.
findings.correction: Change the R 0 callout to a minimum radius that matches the intended cutting tool (e.g., R 0.5 or R 1), or add a note permitting a tool-radius corner.

findings.rule: Surface treatment must suit the base material
findings.reasoning: The title block specifies material 'M.S.' (mild steel) with surface treatment 'I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)'. IZBP stands for Iron Zinc Bright Passivation, which is a post-treatment applied exclusively to zinc-plated parts. Calling out IZBP without first specifying a zinc plating process is incomplete and will result in the vendor being unable to apply the correct finish.
findings.correction: Update the surface treatment field to specify the full coating system, e.g., 'ZINC PLATING + I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)' per the relevant plating standard.
